paite: Deihtakte aw, kha napeuh gingta kei un, himahleh khate Pathian a kipan ahi uhiam hilou chih chian un; khovel a zawlnei taklou tampi ana pawt tak ziak un.
heading: Khate Chian Un
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian Kha na thei ding uh, bang kha peuh Jesu Khrist, sa in ahong pai chih gum tuh Pathian a kipan ahi.
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

paite: Bang kha peuh Jesu gum lou Pathian a kipan ahi kei; huai tuh Khrist doumi kha, hong pai ding na zak uh ahi; tu in khovel ah a-om khinta hi.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

paite: Naute aw, Pathian a kipan na hi ua, tuate na zouta uhi; noumau a om khovel a om sang a athupi zawk ziak in.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

paite: Amau khovel a ahi ua; huaiziak in khovel a bang in apau ua, khovel in athu uh angaikhia hi.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

paite: Eite Pathian a kipan i hi ua, Pathian thei mite'n i thu angaikhe zel uhi; Pathian a kipan lou mite'n bel i thu angaikhe kei uhi. Hiai ah thutak Kha leh thutak lou kha i thei uhi.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

paite: Deihtakte aw, i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh; itna zaw Pathian a suak ahi ngal a, michih itna nei peuhmah Pathian a suak ahi khin ua, Pathian athei lai uhi.
heading: Pathian Itna Ahi
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

paite: Itna nei lou in Pathian athei kei; Pathian itna ahih ziak in.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

paite: Hiai ah Pathian itna i tung uah ahong langta hi, amah ziak a i hintheihna ding a Pathian in a Tapa neihsun khovel a ahon sawlna ah.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

paite: Hiai ah itna a-om, eite'n Pathian i it uh ka chi ahi kei, ama'n ahon it a, i khelhnate thuphatawina ding in, a Tapa ahon sawl ka chi zaw hi.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

paite: Deihtakte aw, Pathian in huchi tel a ahon itleh eite leng i ki-ittuah chiat ding uh ahi.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

paite: Kuamah in chik lai mah in Pathian amu ngei kei hi. I ki-ittuah chiat uleh ei ah Pathian a-om gige dia, a-itna leng eite sung ah akim lai ding hi.
heading: Itna Pathian Muhna Ahi
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

paite: Amah ah i om gige chih leh amah eite sung ah a-om gige chih Kha a hon piak tak ziak in hiai ah i thei hi.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

paite: Huan Pa in Tapa khovel Hondampa hihna nei in ahon sawl chih i muta ua, i theisak uhi.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

paite: Kuapeuh Jesu Pathian Tapa ahi chi a gum amah ah Pathian a-om gige a, amah leng Pathian ah a-om gige hi.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

paite: Pathian in eite a ding in itna anei chih i theita ua, i gingta lai uhi. Pathian itna ahi; itna a om gige mi Pathian ah a-om a, Pathian leng amah ah a-om hi.
heading: Itna Buchinna
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

paite: Hiai ah i tung uah itna akimta, vaihawm ni a ding a lau lou a i omtheihna ah; amah om bang a khovel a i om ziak in.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

paite: Itna ah launa a-om kei, itna kim in lauhna adelhkhe zaw zel hi, lauhna in gawtna ahon ngaihtuahsak; alaumi peuhmah itna ah abukim nai kei hi.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

paite: Ama'n ahon it masak ziak in i it uhi.
heading: Pathian Itna Leh Sanggamte Itna
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

paite: Mi'n, "Pathian ka it," chi in a-unau ho taleh amah zuauthei ahi; a-unau amuhsa bawn a-it kei in, Pathian amuh ngei louhpi bangchi in a-it thei dia?
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

paite: Amah kiang a kipan in hiai thupiak i nei uhi, kuapeuh in Pathian a-itleh a-unau leng a-it sam ding chihna ahi.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
